steps.instruction:

在交接件中加入「資料契約、介面與不變量」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：TTL 限制保留時間但不是強一致保證；舊讀者可能在新寫者失效 cache 後再填入舊值。 交付可供另一人重建的輸入表，任何自行加入的假設需另列。
以本課決策條件作有條件結論：追蹤資料庫更新與 cache miss 填入交錯，辨識 stale fill。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。
steps.instructionEn:
Create soft-v29-121-evidence with input.csv or an event table,baseline calculations,changed outcomes,diagnosis and acceptance records. Deliver consistency requirements,TTL,invalidation/version policy and race tests; cache is not the sole source of truth. Retain source URL,runtime and model limits.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for Data contracts,interfaces and invariants: TTL bounds retention rather than guaranteeing strong consistency; an old reader may refill stale data after invalidation. Deliver reconstructible input tables and list every added assumption.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Trace interleaved database updates and cache misses to identify stale fills. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.

stages.title: 資料契約、介面與不變量
stages.description: 追蹤資料庫更新與 cache miss 填入交錯，辨識 stale fill。 cache TTL=60 s；T1 讀 DB v1 後暫停，T2 寫 v2 並清 cache，T1 於 t=5 填 v1。 將鍵、型別、時間或版本欄分列，指出每筆資料的唯一身份；對NULL、重複或無限邊界做明確約定。
stages.descriptionEn: Trace interleaved database updates and cache misses to identify stale fills. TTL is 60 s; T1 reads DB v1 then pauses,T2 writes v2 and invalidates,T1 fills v1 at t=5. Tabulate keys,types,time/version fields and stable identities; explicitly handle NULLs,duplicates and unbounded endpoints.
